story: Stage 5 of Tour de Suisse 2026 saw an early break of 11 riders, with Vervaeke securing the King of the Mountains jersey. UAE Team Emirates kept the gap small, while Dekathlon led the peloton. Pogacar attacked near the end, overtook Martinez just before the finish, and won by 7 seconds, securing both the stage and the overall lead.
